name: A11y Enhancer
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
A11y Enhancer transforms your WordPress site into an accessibility powerhouse! 🚀 This free plugin offers a sleek widget with font size toggles, high-contrast mode, text spacing, grayscale, link underlining, and screen reader support. Move or close the widget for a seamless experience. Available in 15 languages: English (US, UK, CA, AU), German, French, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Polish, Chinese (Simplified), and Russian. 🌍

🔍 Free Features:
– 🔤 Font size toggle
– 🌗 High-contrast mode
– 📏 Text spacing
– ⚫ Grayscale mode
– 🔗 Underline links
– 🎧 Screen reader mode
– ↔️ Move/close widget
– 📊 Basic alt text report

🛠️ Pro Features: AI alt-text, WCAG reports, and more at pluginjoy.com.

Word count: 103
sections.installation:
1. Upload a11y-enhancer to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu.
  3. Configure at Settings > A11y Enhancer. 🛠️
  4. Add [a11y_enhancer] shortcode for custom placement.
  5. Place .mo files in /languages/ and set site language in Settings > General. 🌍
  6. Include Font Awesome 6.4.0 in /assets/css/ to avoid warnings.
  7. Upgrade to Pro at pluginjoy.com for AI and WCAG tools.
sections.faq:
What’s in the free version?

Font size, high-contrast, text spacing, grayscale, link underlining, screen reader mode, widget move/close, and a basic alt text report. ✨

Which languages are supported?

15 languages: English (US, UK, CA, AU), German, French, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Polish, Chinese (Simplified), Russian. Add .mo files to /languages/ and set site language. 🌍

How do I get Pro features?

Visit pluginjoy.com for AI alt-text, WCAG reports, and advanced tools. 🛠️

Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes! Fully responsive with touch-optimized controls. 📱

How do I ensure WCAG compliance?

Free version helps; Pro offers full WCAG 2.1 reports at pluginjoy.com. 📊
